hyperedges.label: Resume Template System
hyperedges.desc: All 5 templates follow same pattern: accept ResumeData+ResumeMetadata props, destructure sections with defaults, apply theme via CSS custom properties, use SharedComponents for contact/profile rendering

hyperedges.label: Dialog Primitives Duo
hyperedges.desc: Both use @base-ui/react/dialog primitives. Dialog is the base, AlertDialog extends the same primitives with alert-specific composability (Root, Trigger, Portal, Overlay/Backdrop, Popup, Title, Description, Close). AlertDialogAction/Cancel both use DialogPrimitive.Close with render prop.

hyperedges.label: External Specialized Library Consumers
hyperedges.desc: Chart uses recharts for data visualization. FileUpload uses motion/react for animation and react-dropzone for drag-and-drop. Both are heavier dependencies compared to other UI components.

hyperedges.label: Composition Over Primitives
hyperedges.desc: InputGroup wraps Input, Button, and Textarea. Command wraps Dialog, InputGroup. Both demonstrate higher-level composed components over lower-level primitives.

hyperedges.label: Inline Conditional Rendering Pattern
hyperedges.desc: These 2 templates use inline conditional rendering (sectionVisibility check + data length check) directly in JSX rather than the sectionRenderers pattern

hyperedges.label: sectionRenderers Pattern
hyperedges.desc: These 3 templates use the sectionRenderers Record<string, () => ReactNode> pattern for conditional section rendering, iterated with Object.keys(sectionRenderers).map()

hyperedges.label: class-variance-authority Consumers
hyperedges.desc: These 4 component modules use class-variance-authority (cva) for type-safe variant styling with variant/size/orientation/align props

hyperedges.label: @base-ui/react Primitive Consumers
hyperedges.desc: These 7 component files import and wrap @base-ui/react primitives (dialog, avatar, button, checkbox, dialog, menu, input) with Tailwind styling via cn()

hyperedges.label: Subscription Plan Tiers
hyperedges.description: 7 plans seeded: Free (â‚¹0, 1 scan/mo), Pro Monthly (â‚¹49, originally â‚¹99), Pro Quarterly (â‚¹129, originally â‚¹299), Pro Yearly (â‚¹399, originally â‚¹699), Max Monthly (â‚¹199, originally â‚¹399), Max Quarterly (â‚¹499, originally â‚¹999), Max Yearly (â‚¹1,499, originally â‚¹2,999). Pro/Max plans have 18% GST. Max includes unlimited scans, AI coaching, human review.

hyperedges.label: Resume Type System
hyperedges.description: Comprehensive JSON Resume standard extended with ResumeData (basics, work, education, skills, projects, certifications, languages, volunteer, awards, publications, references, customSections, inferredJobTitles), ResumeMetadata (theme, typography, page, section layout), template system (TemplateProps, TemplateMeta, TemplateCategory, TemplateLayout), ATS analysis types, and industry profiles.

hyperedges.label: Referral System Full Flow
hyperedges.description: Referral code gen â†’ validation on signup â†’ claim after auth â†’ conversion on payment success (webhook) â†’ reward coupon issuance for both referrer and referee. Self-referral, duplicate referral, and double-conversion blocked at DB and app level.

hyperedges.label: Database Seeding Pipeline
hyperedges.description: Scripts seed the database: seed-job-titles seeds normalized job titles from a GitHub dataset, seed-plans seeds 7 subscription tiers. Both use Drizzle ORM with Neon serverless Postgres.

hyperedges.label: Redux State Architecture
hyperedges.description: Store combines authSlice and resumeSlice; Providers wraps app with Redux Provider. ResumeSlice is the largest slice with 40+ reducers for full resume CRUD.

hyperedges.label: Billing Module Dependency Chain
hyperedges.description: The complete billing flow: WebhookService orchestrates InvoiceService â†’ PaymentService â†’ SubscriptionService â†’ CouponService â†’ ReferralService, all sharing billing-utils and billing types

hyperedges.label: AI Usage Cost Tracking
hyperedges.description: usage.service.ts maintains a MODEL_RATES table for Google Gemini (flash, flash-lite, pro, 2.0, 1.5) and OpenAI (gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1 series). Computes cost = (promptTokens/1000)*inputRate + (completionTokens/1000)*outputRate. Fire-and-forget logging to aiUsageLog table.

nodes.label: Resume Builder Actual Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Actual implementation on branch feat/resume-builder; uses Redux (resumeSlice) instead of Zustand; 5 templates implemented (3 free, 2 premium); all 4 AI features done; drag-and-drop via dnd-kit; Tiptap rich text; 11 section forms.

nodes.label: Deepseek Resume Builder Comprehensive Plan
nodes.rationale: Designed to be world-class, multi-industry; proposes Zustand for state management; 15-20 templates across industries; dual PDF engine (HTML-to-PDF via Puppeteer + LaTeX for premium); ATS scoring with 10 weighted criteria; AI features for content enhancement, summary generation, tailoring, and roast.

nodes.label: AI-Powered Resume Features
nodes.rationale: Four AI features: bullet point enhancement (STAR method), professional summary generation, ATS scoring against job description, and resume roast (humorous critique). All implemented via API routes with aiActionEnum tracking.

nodes.label: ATS (Applicant Tracking System) Scoring Engine
nodes.rationale: 10 weighted scoring criteria: section headings (15%), no tables/columns (10%), no images (10%), standard fonts (5%), keyword density (30%), quantified achievements (10%), date formats (5%), file format (5%), contact info (5%), no spelling errors (5%). Color-coded badge UI: red <60, yellow 60-80, green >80.

nodes.label: Dual-Engine PDF Export
nodes.rationale: Primary: Puppeteer HTML-to-PDF with @sparticuz/chromium-min for serverless; Premium: LaTeX via pdflatex in Docker sidecar; Fallback: window.print() with @media print CSS. Handles content overflow, font loading, Unicode, multi-page breaks.

nodes.label: Resume Builder Architecture (3-Panel Editor)
nodes.rationale: Three-panel layout: Section Navigation (left) | Form Editor (center) | Live Preview (right). Redux-powered state with dual-tier auto-save (2s localStorage, 15s server). 11 section forms, settings panel, template picker.

nodes.label: Resume Builder Database Schema
nodes.rationale: Drizzle ORM schema with 7 tables: resumes (core JSONB), templates, resumeVersions (version history), exports (PDF/DOCX tracking), atsAnalyses (scoring results), sharedLinks (public sharing with optional password); extends users table with default_industry and default_template_id.

nodes.label: ResumeData JSONB Schema (JSON Resume Extended)
nodes.rationale: Extended JSON Resume standard covering 11+ section types: basics, work, education, skills, projects, certifications, languages, volunteer, awards, publications, references, customSections. Stored as JSONB in PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: Resume Template System
nodes.rationale: Code-driven registry with lazy-loaded React components; each template conforms to TemplateProps interface; supports CSS custom properties for live theme switching; 5 templates implemented (Minimalist, TechStack, ExecutivePro, CreativePortfolio, ModernSplit) with ATS scores and tier (Free/Pro).

hyperedges.label: Resume Template System
hyperedges.desc: All 5 templates follow same pattern: accept ResumeData+ResumeMetadata props, destructure sections with defaults, apply theme via CSS custom properties, use SharedComponents for contact/profile rendering

hyperedges.label: Dialog Primitives Duo
hyperedges.desc: Both use @base-ui/react/dialog primitives. Dialog is the base, AlertDialog extends the same primitives with alert-specific composability (Root, Trigger, Portal, Overlay/Backdrop, Popup, Title, Description, Close). AlertDialogAction/Cancel both use DialogPrimitive.Close with render prop.

hyperedges.label: External Specialized Library Consumers
hyperedges.desc: Chart uses recharts for data visualization. FileUpload uses motion/react for animation and react-dropzone for drag-and-drop. Both are heavier dependencies compared to other UI components.

hyperedges.label: Composition Over Primitives
hyperedges.desc: InputGroup wraps Input, Button, and Textarea. Command wraps Dialog, InputGroup. Both demonstrate higher-level composed components over lower-level primitives.

hyperedges.label: Inline Conditional Rendering Pattern
hyperedges.desc: These 2 templates use inline conditional rendering (sectionVisibility check + data length check) directly in JSX rather than the sectionRenderers pattern

hyperedges.label: sectionRenderers Pattern
hyperedges.desc: These 3 templates use the sectionRenderers Record<string, () => ReactNode> pattern for conditional section rendering, iterated with Object.keys(sectionRenderers).map()

hyperedges.label: class-variance-authority Consumers
hyperedges.desc: These 4 component modules use class-variance-authority (cva) for type-safe variant styling with variant/size/orientation/align props

hyperedges.label: @base-ui/react Primitive Consumers
hyperedges.desc: These 7 component files import and wrap @base-ui/react primitives (dialog, avatar, button, checkbox, dialog, menu, input) with Tailwind styling via cn()

hyperedges.label: Subscription Plan Tiers
hyperedges.description: 7 plans seeded: Free (â‚¹0, 1 scan/mo), Pro Monthly (â‚¹49, originally â‚¹99), Pro Quarterly (â‚¹129, originally â‚¹299), Pro Yearly (â‚¹399, originally â‚¹699), Max Monthly (â‚¹199, originally â‚¹399), Max Quarterly (â‚¹499, originally â‚¹999), Max Yearly (â‚¹1,499, originally â‚¹2,999). Pro/Max plans have 18% GST. Max includes unlimited scans, AI coaching, human review.

hyperedges.label: Resume Type System
hyperedges.description: Comprehensive JSON Resume standard extended with ResumeData (basics, work, education, skills, projects, certifications, languages, volunteer, awards, publications, references, customSections, inferredJobTitles), ResumeMetadata (theme, typography, page, section layout), template system (TemplateProps, TemplateMeta, TemplateCategory, TemplateLayout), ATS analysis types, and industry profiles.

hyperedges.label: Referral System Full Flow
hyperedges.description: Referral code gen â†’ validation on signup â†’ claim after auth â†’ conversion on payment success (webhook) â†’ reward coupon issuance for both referrer and referee. Self-referral, duplicate referral, and double-conversion blocked at DB and app level.

hyperedges.label: Database Seeding Pipeline
hyperedges.description: Scripts seed the database: seed-job-titles seeds normalized job titles from a GitHub dataset, seed-plans seeds 7 subscription tiers. Both use Drizzle ORM with Neon serverless Postgres.

hyperedges.label: Redux State Architecture
hyperedges.description: Store combines authSlice and resumeSlice; Providers wraps app with Redux Provider. ResumeSlice is the largest slice with 40+ reducers for full resume CRUD.

hyperedges.label: Billing Module Dependency Chain
hyperedges.description: The complete billing flow: WebhookService orchestrates InvoiceService â†’ PaymentService â†’ SubscriptionService â†’ CouponService â†’ ReferralService, all sharing billing-utils and billing types

hyperedges.label: AI Usage Cost Tracking
hyperedges.description: usage.service.ts maintains a MODEL_RATES table for Google Gemini (flash, flash-lite, pro, 2.0, 1.5) and OpenAI (gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1 series). Computes cost = (promptTokens/1000)*inputRate + (completionTokens/1000)*outputRate. Fire-and-forget logging to aiUsageLog table.
